# McCulloch Jewellers

> Family jewellers on The Square in Beeston, Nottingham, UK. Engagement rings, wedding rings, fine jewellery and watches, made, set and repaired by hand in our own workshop, with natural and lab-grown diamonds and bespoke design.

- Address: 7 The Square, Beeston, Nottingham NG9 2JG, United Kingdom
- Telephone: 0115 925 7552
- Email: has@mccullochjewellers.co.uk
- Opening hours: Monday to Saturday 9:30–17:00; closed Sunday
- Delivery: free insured UK delivery; 1-year warranty; 30-day returns on ready-to-ship pieces
- Bespoke: designed with you and made in our workshop, usually around six weeks
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/andrewmccullochjewellers/
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/andrewmccullochjewellers/

## Shop

- [Engagement rings](https://mccullochjewellers.co.uk/engagement-rings): set by hand in our Beeston workshop; natural or lab-grown diamonds; platinum or 9ct, 14ct and 18ct gold
- [Wedding rings](https://mccullochjewellers.co.uk/wedding-rings): over a thousand designs made to your size in platinum, palladium and gold
- [All rings](https://mccullochjewellers.co.uk/rings): engagement, wedding, eternity, gemstone and ready-to-ship rings
- [Earrings](https://mccullochjewellers.co.uk/earrings): diamond and gemstone studs, halos, hoops and drops
- [Necklaces and pendants](https://mccullochjewellers.co.uk/necklaces)
- [Bracelets](https://mccullochjewellers.co.uk/bracelets): gold link and station bracelets, many made to order in 9ct or 18ct gold
- [Watches](https://mccullochjewellers.co.uk/watches): Roamer, Briston and Festina
- [Bespoke design](https://mccullochjewellers.co.uk/bespoke-design)
